SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Self- Improvement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Self- Improvement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Improvement.
   C. Say Self- Improvement never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Self- Improvement as rumours only.

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Destroying road signs

3. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal skills is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal skills.
   B. Say Diversity and interpersonal skills never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Diversity and interpersonal skills as rumours only.
   D. Explain Diversity and interpersonal skills with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Scientific Theory about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Scientific Theory about Human Origin as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Scientific Theory about Human Origin.
   D. Say Scientific Theory about Human Origin never happens in Kenya.

5. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Hide all money underground

6. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nakuru
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nairobi

7. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Name the president
   D. Replace the compass rose

8. Which statement about Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ●.

9. Which statement about Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe as rumours only.
   B. Explain Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe.

10. Which statement about Population Growth in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Population Growth in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Population Growth in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Population Growth in Africa.
   D. Treat Population Growth in Africa as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration as rumours only.
   B. Say Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration.

12. Which statement about Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain as rumours only.
   B. Say Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain.
   D. Explain Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. Which statement about Trans Saharan Slave Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Trans Saharan Slave Trade never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Trans Saharan Slave Trade as rumours only.
   C. Explain Trans Saharan Slave Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Trans Saharan Slave Trade.

14. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   B. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   C. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. Which statement about Self- Esteem Assessment is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Self- Esteem Assessment with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Self- Esteem Assessment as rumours only.
   C. Say Self- Esteem Assessment never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Esteem Assessment.

16. Which statement about Vegetation in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Africa.
